transformations.name: Transformation calculation.country_dimension
transformations.expression: LEI_DATA[calc identifier COUNTRY_INCORPORATION := nvl(COUNTRY_INCORPORATION, ""), identifier COUNTRY_HEADQUARTERS := nvl(COUNTRY_HEADQUARTERS, "")]

transformations.name: Transformation calculation.number_incorporated_entities
transformations.expression: count(calculation.country_dimension#LEI group by COUNTRY_INCORPORATION)[calc identifier TYPE_MEASURE := "NUMBER_INCORPORATED_ENTITIES"][rename int_var to OBS_VALUE, COUNTRY_INCORPORATION to COUNTRY]

transformations.name: Transformation calculation.number_hq_entities
transformations.expression: count(calculation.country_dimension#LEI group by COUNTRY_HEADQUARTERS)[calc identifier TYPE_MEASURE := "NUMBER_HQ_ENTITIES"][rename int_var to OBS_VALUE, COUNTRY_HEADQUARTERS to COUNTRY]

transformations.name: Transformation calculation.number_entities_different_hq
transformations.expression: count(calculation.country_dimension_diff_hq#LEI group by COUNTRY_INCORPORATION)[calc identifier TYPE_MEASURE := "NUMBER_ENTITIES_DIFF_HQ"][rename int_var to OBS_VALUE, COUNTRY_INCORPORATION to COUNTRY]
